S.meta.title: Orbit Dash — umdlalo wesigqi womkhathi othepha kanye
S.meta.desc: Imizila emibili, ukuthepha okukodwa. Gxuma ngesigqi emazingeni omculo akhiwe ngomculo wethu, phila emjahweni ongapheli futhi uqoqe imisila yebhola lakho. Mahhala ku-Android — futhi ungadlala ngqo kusiphequluli.
S.nav.label: Izingxenye zesayithi
S.hero.sub: Umdlalo wesigqi we-neon emkhathini ojulile. Thepha ukushintsha umzila, ushelele phakathi kwameva ngesigqi somculo futhi uvuse izinkanyezi, ingoma ngengoma.
S.live.hint: Lona umdlalo wangempela. Thepha isikrini ukuze udlale izinga ngokwakho.
S.levels.title: Izinga ngalinye liyingoma
S.levels.lead: Amazinga enziwe ngesandla phezu kwezingoma ezibhalelwe umdlalo. Ameva awela esigubhini, ukukhanya kuyashintsha ngengxenye ngayinye, futhi ukunqoba kwakho kokuqala kukunika umsila omusha.
S.levels.note: Izingcezu zemizuzwana eyi-12. Izingoma eziphelele zisemdlalweni.
S.how.title: Funda ngomzuzwana. Kuzwe amasonto.
S.how.1.d: Ibhola lakho ligijima lizungeza indandatho. Thepha kanye noma kuphi bese ligxumela komunye umzila: yikho konke ukulawula.
S.how.2.d: Ameva afika nomculo. Thepha ngesikhathi ukuze ushelele phakathi kwawo, futhi ubambe izinhlansi eziseduze ukuze ukhuphule i-combo ifike ku-x5.
S.how.3.d: Phila kuze kuphele ingoma ukuze uqede izinga. Qoqa wonke amagugu ngama-90% okugxuma kwakho esigqini, futhi inkanyezi izokunika umqhele wayo.
S.blip.title: Hlangana no-Blip
S.blip.lead: U-Blip ungukushaya kokugcina kwenhliziyo yeNkanyezi Enkulu. UKuthula kwaqandisa isibhakabhaka, ngakho ugingqika emizileni ngesigqi somculo, futhi ingoma ngayinye ayidlala kuze kube sekugcineni ivusa inkanyezi.
S.rule.1: Imizila iyimisele yengoma: ingoma izwakala kuphela uma kukhona ogingqika phezu kwayo.
S.rule.2: Ameva yizinkanyezi eziqandiswe uKuthula. Thinta elilodwa bese umculo uyama, kodwa isigqi singaqala kabusha njalo.
S.rule.3: Izinhlansi ngamanothi aphilayo, kanti amagugu ayizingcezu zezingoma. Wabambe useduze, ingoma izokhanya kakhulu.
S.rule.4: Dlala ingoma yenkanyezi kuze kube sekugcineni izovuka. Yidlale ngaphandle kwephutha izokunika umqhele.
S.char.blip.d: Isigqi esiphilayo esinengoma yeNkanyezi Enkulu ngaphakathi. Unelukuluku, unesibindi futhi uyabhuqabhuqa kancane: ukhala kalula, kodwa akalokothi ayeke.
S.char.mom.d: Umama ka-Blip. Wamnika ingoma yakhe yokugcina futhi manje ulele eqhweni kude kakhulu. Isihlabelelo sakhe sokulalisa siyingqikithi enkulu yomdlalo.
S.char.moon.d: Umlindi ozelayo wengoma ehamba kancane. Ucasha emaphusheni, esaba ukuthi umculo uzophela uma evuka.
S.char.vega.d: Inkanyezi ye-neon yeDolobha le-Neon nendlovukazi yesivinini. Akakaze ahlulwe emjahweni: imbangi ka-Blip eyaba umngane.
S.char.silence.d: Akusona isilo, kodwa ukungabikho komculo: inkungu ebandayo ensomi eqandisa izinkanyezi zibe ameva.
S.blip.epsLead: Isiqephu ngasinye siyizinga lomdlalo elinengoma yalo.
S.ep.1: Lapho u-Blip avela khona nenkanyezi yokuqala ayivusayo.
S.ep.2: INyanga iyesaba ukuvuka. U-Blip ufunda ukuthi ikhefu nalo liyingxenye yengoma.
S.ep.3: Umjaho odabula eDolobheni le-Neon, lapho ukubuyela embangini kubaluleke ngaphezu komugqa wokuphela.
S.ep.4: U-Blip ugijima edlula uMthombo Wokuthula, lapho ukwesaba kwehlisa ijubane lesikhathi uqobo — futhi ufunda ukushesha ngaphezu kokwesaba.
S.ep.lights: Uzalwe ekushayeni kokugcina kwenhliziyo yenkanyezi, u-Blip omncane ubheka phezulu esibhakabhakeni esigcwele izibani — udabukile kancane, ujabule kancane. Bese kuyakhithika.
S.ep.onetap: Idolobha elimpunga, elithule. Ukuthepha okukodwa esigqini — bese ubusuku bonke buyakhanya futhi bugiya no-Blip.
S.ep.witch: Ukuthula kuyiqandisile i-Halloween. Ukuthepha okukodwa esigqini — bese ithanga liyavutha, amalulwane andize, futhi u-Blip udweba imizila yokuzungeza yobusuku.
S.ep.witchdw: Ubusuku obufanayo be-Halloween, nengoma emnyama kakhulu: darkwave, amalulwane nomthakathi ogibele umshanelo — futhi ukuthepha ngakunye kusawela esigqini.
S.ep.hype: U-Blip ufaka izibuko zakhe zelanga — bese wonke umthala ugiya nesigqi.
S.shop.title: Yenza ibhola libe ngelakho
S.shop.lead: Imisila, ukubukeka nokuthuthukiswa. Umsila ngamunye lapha udwetshwa bukhoma yinjini yemisila yomdlalo uqobo: thepha owodwa ukuze uwuzame.
S.feat.title: Okungaphakathi
S.feat.endless.d: Ayikho ingoma, awukho umugqa wokuphela: izindandatho ziyaqhubeka zisheshisa. Uzobekezela isikhathi esingakanani?
S.feat.revive.d: Uwe ujule ezingeni? Vuka khona lapho ubukhona uqhubeke, noma uphinde kabili amagugu osanda kuwathola. Umqhele ubalwa kuphela uma ungavukanga.
S.feat.practice.d: Zilolonge kusukela ezindaweni zokuhlola ngaphandle kwengcindezi. Uma usulungile, dlala ngempela kusukela ekuqaleni.
S.feat.combo.d: Bamba izinhlansi eziseduze kwameva ukuze ukhuphule i-combo ifike ku-x5, futhi uthathe izikhuthazi: isihlangu, uzibuthe, amagugu aphindwe kabili, ukunyakaza okunensa nokushaya okuphihliza ameva.
S.feat.daily.d: Imisebenzi emithathu emisha nsuku zonke nochungechunge lwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Usuku lwesikhombisa lunika kakhulu.
S.feat.ranks.d: Yonke irekhodi elisha liya kumabhodi abaholi e-Google Play Games. Shaya abangane bakho, bese kuba umhlaba wonke.
S.feat.music.d: Yonke ingoma, kusukela ezingqikithini zemenyu kuya kuzo zonke izinga, yabhalelwa i-Orbit Dash. Khetha ingqikithi yemenyu kusidlali samarekhodi kuzilungiselelo.
S.feat.langs.d: Umdlalo naleli sayithi kukhuluma ulimi lwakho. Umdlalo uzikhethela ngokwawo ulimi lwefoni yakho. Lushintshe noma nini ngembulunga kuzilungiselelo.
S.shots.title: Buka ngaphakathi
S.play.title: Dlala manje
S.play.lead: Wonke umdlalo usebenza kusiphequluli sakho, ocingweni noma kukhompyutha, ngaphandle kokufaka lutho. Inqubekela phambili ihlala kulesi siphequluli; uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Android lunolwalo.
S.studio.title: Mayelana nathi
S.foot.noTrack: Akukho zikhangiso, ukuhlaziywa noma amakhukhi kuleli sayithi.

S.g:Watch the whole level play itself, bea: Buka lonke izinga lizidlalela, isigqi ngesigqi. Imigijimo ye-autoplay ayitholi amagugu.
S.studio.text: I-Lewydo yisitudiyo esincane semidlalo sabantu ababili sase-Ukraine. U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi, u-Lilya uyaklama. Ndawonye senza imidlalo esithanda ukuyidlala.
